# dsh-temp-task · Temporary tasks
> A "Temporary tasks" area above Workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: ask a quick question, t
ry a snippet, and get a throwaway folder and conversation in one click — without polluting your work
t, and get a throwaway folder and conversation in one click — without polluting your workspace list.
`DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2+` · `Windows / macOS / Linux` · `English / 中文 / 日本語 / Español / Français / D
eutsch / Русский / Português` · `MIT`
## Why
DSH needs a workspace (a folder) before a conversation can start. For a quick question or a small ex
periment, that setup step gets in the way.
WorkBuddy's task area solves this: click New task and it creates a temporary folder, then drops you
straight into the work.
dsh-temp-task adds a sibling area **above** Workspaces for exactly those throwaway tasks:
- Click **New temporary task** and the folder, workspace and session are ready; you land in the conv

ersation.
- Tasks sit in a flat list inside the area; one click opens their own conversation and the

y don't take up a workspace slot.
- When you're done, right-click to delete the task alone or the ta
sk plus its folder (into the recycle bin). Switch away without sending a single message and it's rec
laimed automatically.
## What a temporary task is
Each temporary task is **one real workspace + one session + one folder on disk**. Rename, archive, p
in and move all reuse DSH's native capabilities, so state stays in sync with the official UI.

## Features
### Sidebar area

- Sits above Workspaces with its own header, `Temporary tasks`.
- Those temporary workspaces are hid
den from the official list (whole groups in grouped view, their session rows in flat view), so nothi
ng leaks into Workspaces.
### Task rows
- Same size, spacing, background and type scale as official workspace rows, with the same folder ico

n at the start.
- When the open conversation is this task's session, the folder switches to the blue

open state, matching a selected workspace row.
- Titles show the **session title** first (DSH's ses
sion-titles summarizes after each turn); before a title exists it falls back to `临时 · MM-DD HH:mm`.
- Each row carries the same three buttons as official session rows: **⋯ menu → archive → pin**. Pinn
ed rows show a pin at the start.
### Search, sort and filter
- Magnifier: expands a search box in place and filters by title; `Esc` or the clear button collapses

it.
- Sliders: opens the same view menu as the workspace header — Order by (Manual / Last updated)

and Filter sessions (Hide archived / All conversations / Archived only).
- The sort preference is st
ored in `localStorage`.
### Context menu
Ordered like the official session menu:
| Item | Behavior |

| Pin / Unpin | Uses the official session pin; pinned tasks move to the top of the area |
| Rename |

Inline edit of the session title; once set, auto-summarizing stops overwriting it |
| Copy session

ID | Copies the session ID to the clipboard |
| Archive / Unarchive | Uses the official session arch

ive; archived tasks are hidden by the filter by default |
| Move to workspace | Promotes the task in
place: the folder stays put; the temporary workspace is unregistered and the same path is registere

d as a regular workspace |
| Remove from sidebar (keep folder) | Archives the session, unregisters t

he workspace and deletes the record; folder and files stay |
| Delete temporary task (with folder) |
Archives the session, moves the folder to the recycle bin, then unregisters the workspace |
### New sessions start as temporary tasks
A switch in the plugin settings controls this behavior.
On by default: clicking **New session** at the top creates and opens a temporary task immediately —
no workspace picker. The workspace dropdown on the new-session page also gains a **New temporary tas
pace picker. The workspace dropdown on the new-session page also gains a **New temporary task** row.
Turn the switch off and both the top button and the dropdown return to DSH's native behavior.
### Empty tasks are reclaimed
Create a task and switch to another session without sending a message and the task is deleted immedi
ately: workspace unregistered, record removed, empty folder deleted (if the folder already holds oth
er files it goes to the recycle bin instead). This matches DSH's own "blank session disappears when
you switch away" behavior.
Tasks that have sent messages are never reclaimed.
### Long titles scroll
When a title is clipped, hovering the row scrolls it to reveal the rest, just like workspace session
s; moving away snaps back to the start. It scrolls only when more than 8px is hidden, and jumps stra
ight to the end when the system's reduced-motion setting is on.
### Settings
**Settings → Temporary tasks** (or **Settings → Plugins → dsh-temp-task**) lets you change:
- **Storage location** — parent folder for new task folders; defaults to `~/Documents/deepseek-harne

ss`.
- **Folder prefix** — default `临时`; used in folder names and fallback titles.
- **New sessions
start a temporary task** — on by default; see above.
Every setting has a "?" that shows its help on hover. **Changes apply to newly created tasks only**:
existing folders don't move or get renamed, and can still be opened, archived and deleted as before
existing folders don't move or get renamed, and can still be opened, archived and deleted as before.
## Known limitations
- The sidebar area, task rows and new-session entry point are **DOM-level integrations** that depend
on the official sidebar structure. If an upstream change removes the anchors, the plugin **stops si

lently** and the native UI takes over — nothing else breaks.
- The view menu uses the official `prim
itives.Menu`. If the runtime can't provide `react` / `react-dom/client`, that button disappears; sea

rch, folding, ⊕ and the other pure-DOM features keep working.
- Linux without a desktop environment
may lack `gio`; deletes then report an error and ask you to move the folder to the recycle bin manua
lly. On macOS the Finder fallback may ask for Automation permission once. Neither platform ever dele

tes by mistake.
- In grouped view the temporary area is capped at `42vh` and scrolls internally when
you have many tasks.
